items.title: Q3 Company Update
items.content:
## Platform Upgrade

We are excited to announce that our platform has been **upgraded** with new enterprise features including:

- Managed assistants
- Enterprise updates
- Managed memory seed

Visit the [documentation](https://docs.example.com) for details.

items.title: Scheduled Maintenance Window
items.content: The platform will be under maintenance on 2026-08-30 from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC. Expect brief interruptions.
